intro: This unit is about where and how to shop. Grammar: (1) 虽然……，但是…… “although…, (but)…” and how 不过 differs from 但是; (2) A 不如 B “A is not as good as B”; (3) making suggestions with ……，好吗？ / 怎么样？ / 行吗？. Answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet.

key_sentences.zh: 买衣服、鞋什么的，应该去哪儿啊？
key_sentences.py: Mǎi yīfu, xié shénmede, yīnggāi qù nǎr a?
key_sentences.en: Where should you go to buy clothes, shoes and things like that?

key_sentences.zh: （去服装市场）虽然东西便宜得多，但是质量可能不如商场的好。
key_sentences.py: (Qù fúzhuāng shìchǎng) suīrán dōngxi piányi de duō, dànshì zhìliàng kěnéng bùrú shāngchǎng de hǎo.
key_sentences.en: (At a clothing market) although things are much cheaper, the quality may not be as good as in a department store.

key_sentences.zh: 星期天你陪我逛雅秀市场，怎么样？
key_sentences.py: Xīngqītiān nǐ péi wǒ guàng Yǎxiù shìchǎng, zěnmeyàng?
key_sentences.en: How about you come with me to Yaxiu Market on Sunday?

title.en: Transitional compound sentence: 虽然……，但是……

body.zh: “虽然……但是……”构成表示转折关系的复句。“虽然”用于第一个分句，既可以在主语前，也可以在主语后。“但是”应该在第二分句句首。例如：
body.py: “Suīrán…… dànshì……” gòuchéng biǎoshì zhuǎnzhé guānxi de fùjù. “Suīrán” yòngyú dì-yī ge fēnjù, jì kěyǐ zài zhǔyǔ qián, yě kěyǐ zài zhǔyǔ hòu. “Dànshì” yīnggāi zài dì-èr fēnjù jùshǒu. Lìrú:
body.en: “虽然……但是……” forms a transitional compound sentence. “虽然” is used in the first clause, either before or after the subject, and “但是” must be at the beginning of the second clause, e.g.,

body.zh: （主语）虽然……，但是 + 第二分句
body.en: (subject) although…, but + second clause — 但是 always starts the second clause

body.zh: 虽然我们很累，但是我们都很高兴。
body.py: Suīrán wǒmen hěn lèi, dànshì wǒmen dōu hěn gāoxìng.
body.en: Although we're tired, we're all very happy.

body.zh: “不过”和“但是”都是表示转折语气的连词，用在后半句。二者不同之处在于，“不过”只表示轻微的转折，没有“但是”转折的语气强烈；“不过”多用于口语。例如：
body.en: “不过” and “但是” are both conjunctions used in the second clause to indicate a turn. The difference: “不过” shows only a slight turn and is weaker than “但是”; “不过” is mostly used in spoken Chinese, e.g.,

body.zh: 那个手机很漂亮，不过有点儿贵。
body.py: Nàge shǒujī hěn piàoliang, búguò yǒudiǎnr guì.
body.en: That phone is very nice, though it's a bit expensive.

body.zh: 我很想去，但是没有时间。
body.py: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù, dànshì méiyǒu shíjiān.
body.en: I'd really like to go, but I don't have time.
✓ 虽然这个电视比较贵，但是质量非常好. ✗ …，质量但是非常好 — 但是 can't come after the subject of the second clause.
“A不如B” means “A is not as good as B”, e.g.,

body.py: Zhè běn shū bùrú nà běn shū.
body.en: This book isn't as good as that one.

body.zh: “不如”后边一般是表示积极意义的词语。例如：
body.en: “不如” is generally followed by words with a positive meaning, e.g.,
He isn't as tall as his elder brother.

body.zh: “A不如B+形容词”中形容词前没有副词。例如：
body.en: In “A不如B + adjective”, the adjective is not preceded by an adverb, e.g.,

body.zh: 这个手机质量不如那个好。
body.py: Zhège shǒujī zhìliàng bùrú nàge hǎo.
body.en: The quality of this phone isn't as good as that one's.

body.zh: A + 不如 + B + （积极的形容词）
body.en: A is not as (good/big/many…) as B — positive adjective, no 很
✓ 商店的东西不如市场的多 (not as many) — ✗ 不如市场的少. ✓ 不如水果好吃 — ✗ 不如水果很好吃.

title.zh: 用“好吗”“怎么样”“行吗”的疑问句
title.en: Questions with 好吗, 怎么样 and 行吗

body.zh: 在提出建议征询对方的意见时，可以使用“好吗”“怎么样”“行吗”提问。问句的前一部分是陈述句。例如：
body.en: When making a suggestion and asking for the other person's opinion, add “好吗”, “怎么样” or “行吗” after a statement, e.g.,

body.zh: 陈述句（建议），+ 好吗？／怎么样？／行吗？
body.py: chénshùjù (jiànyì), + hǎo ma? / zěnmeyàng? / xíng ma?
body.en: suggestion, + OK? / how about it? / is that alright?
Let's have some tea, OK?

body.zh: 星期天你陪我逛雅秀市场，怎么样？
body.py: Xīngqītiān nǐ péi wǒ guàng Yǎxiù shìchǎng, zěnmeyàng?
body.en: How about you come with me to Yaxiu Market on Sunday?
Is it alright if I go tomorrow?

body.zh: 表示同意时可以用“好”“行”回答。
body.en: Reply with “好” or “行” to show agreement.
These ask for agreement, so answer with agreement or refusal (好啊 / 行 / 不行，我…), not with a description: ✗ 雅秀市场很好.

instructions.zh: 比较北京和你的家乡（或者别的地方）有什么不同，哪个地方更适合居住。请用“不如”进行介绍，说得越多越好。
instructions.en: Compare Beijing and your hometown (or another place): how are they different, and which is more livable? Use “不如”, and say as much as you can.

items.zh: 大，多，干净，漂亮，热，冷，高楼大厦，出租车，公共汽车，自行车，超市，商场，名胜古迹……
items.py: dà, duō, gānjìng, piàoliang, rè, lěng, gāolóu dàshà, chūzūchē, gōnggòng qìchē, zìxíngchē, chāoshì, shāngchǎng, míngshèng gǔjì……
items.en: Useful words: big, many, clean, beautiful, hot, cold, high-rises, taxis, buses, bicycles, supermarkets, malls, historic sites…

answer.zh: 我的家乡不如北京大，高楼大厦也不如北京多。
answer.en: My hometown isn't as big as Beijing, and it doesn't have as many high-rises. (model answer)

answer.zh: 我们那儿的公共汽车不如北京的多，不过骑自行车很方便。
answer.en: There aren't as many buses where I'm from as in Beijing, but cycling is convenient. (model answer)

answer.zh: 北京冬天很冷，空气也不如我的家乡干净。我觉得我的家乡更适合居住。
answer.en: Beijing is very cold in winter, and the air isn't as clean as in my hometown. I think my hometown is more livable. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 班里要举办一次联欢活动，商量一下具体的活动细节。请用“……，好吗？”“……，怎么样？”“……，行吗？”尽量多地进行提议。并向全班表演你们组的讨论过程。
instructions.en: Your class is going to have a party. Discuss the details, making as many suggestions as possible with “……，好吗？”, “……，怎么样？” and “……，行吗？”. Then act out your group's discussion for the class.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 晚上一起去唱卡拉OK，好吗？
lines.py: Wǎnshang yìqǐ qù chàng kǎlā OK, hǎo ma?
lines.en: Let's go to karaoke together in the evening, OK?

prompt.en: Suggest a day for the party.

answer.zh: 我们星期六晚上开联欢会，怎么样？
answer.en: How about we have the party on Saturday evening? (model answer)
Let's have it in the classroom, OK? (model answer)
I'll bring fruit and drinks — is that alright? (model answer)

answer.zh: 好啊！／行，没问题。／不行，星期六我有事。
answer.en: Great! / Sure, no problem. / No good — I'm busy on Saturday. (model answer)

title.py: Rénzhě jiàn rén, zhìzhě jiàn zhì
title.en: The benevolent see benevolence and the wise see wisdom

instructions.zh: 一位同学根据图片谈论自己的印象，另一位同学用“虽然……但是……”发表不同的见解。
instructions.en: One student says what he/she thinks of each picture; the partner gives a different opinion using “虽然……但是……”.

answer.zh: A：苹果很好吃。B：虽然苹果很好吃，但是我更喜欢吃香蕉。
answer.en: A: Apples are tasty. B: Although apples are tasty, I prefer bananas. (model answer)

items.picture: Someone practising Chinese calligraphy with a brush.

answer.zh: A：写毛笔字很有意思。B：虽然很有意思，但是太难了。
answer.en: A: Brush calligraphy is fun. B: Although it's fun, it's too hard. (model answer)

items.picture: A pop-star figure dancing in a black hat and white shirt (a waxwork of a famous singer).

answer.zh: A：他跳舞跳得真好。B：虽然他跳得很好，但是我不太喜欢他的歌。
answer.en: A: He dances really well. B: Although he dances well, I don't really like his songs. (model answer)

items.picture: Two people riding bicycles in a green park.

answer.zh: A：骑自行车很健康。B：虽然很健康，但是夏天骑车太热了。
answer.en: A: Cycling is healthy. B: Although it's healthy, it's too hot to cycle in summer. (model answer)

answer.zh: A：这辆车真漂亮。B：虽然很漂亮，但是太贵了。
answer.en: A: This car is gorgeous. B: Although it's gorgeous, it's far too expensive. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the right sentence or answer to check how well you have learned the grammar.

options.zh: 商店的东西不如市场的多。
options.py: Shāngdiàn de dōngxi bùrú shìchǎng de duō.

options.zh: 商店的东西不如市场的少。
options.py: Shāngdiàn de dōngxi bùrú shìchǎng de shǎo.

questions.explain: 不如 is normally followed by a positive-meaning word (多, 好, 大…). (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 虽然这个电视比较贵，但是质量非常好。
options.py: Suīrán zhège diànshì bǐjiào guì, dànshì zhìliàng fēicháng hǎo.

options.zh: 虽然这个电视比较贵，质量但是非常好。
options.py: Suīrán zhège diànshì bǐjiào guì, zhìliàng dànshì fēicháng hǎo.

questions.explain: 但是 goes at the very start of the second clause. (grammar note 1)

options.zh: 我觉得蔬菜不如水果好吃。
options.py: Wǒ juéde shūcài bùrú shuǐguǒ hǎochī.

options.zh: 我觉得蔬菜不如水果很好吃。
options.py: Wǒ juéde shūcài bùrú shuǐguǒ hěn hǎochī.

questions.explain: No adverb (很) before the adjective in A 不如 B + adjective. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 那个商场虽然不大，但是东西很多。
options.py: Nàge shāngchǎng suīrán bú dà, dànshì dōngxi hěn duō.

options.zh: 那个商场虽然不大，东西但是很多。
options.py: Nàge shāngchǎng suīrán bú dà, dōngxi dànshì hěn duō.

questions.explain: 虽然 may follow the subject, but 但是 must start the second clause. (grammar note 1)

question.zh: 你陪我去雅秀市场，怎么样？
question.py: Nǐ péi wǒ qù Yǎxiù shìchǎng, zěnmeyàng?
question.en: How about coming with me to Yaxiu Market?

questions.explain: “……，怎么样？” asks for your opinion of a suggestion — answer by agreeing (好啊) or declining. (grammar note 3)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！. Missed Q5 — “……，怎么样？” asks whether you accept a suggestion (note 3). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review 不如 (note 2). Missed Q2 or Q4 — review 虽然……但是…… (note 1).
